moworks.notes: Target pulls back ~−10 % (recipe: at 140 ms; the bezier's dip is −9.8 % at 43 % of the time) then accelerates out to 100 % at 400 ms on cubic-bezier(.36,0,.66,−.56) ≈ GSAP back.in(1.7). Rule: an exit's anticipation. Small demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.4 s) · ease (back.in(1.7) | custom .36,0,.66,−.56).
